name: context-to-workspace
query: Make a marketing home for our launch from this chat and our brief. Create it under https://notion.so/team-home.

context.conversation: We need a launch blog and a LinkedIn post. Mira owns the blog draft. No publish dates agreed. Keep it clean and compact.

sources.https://notion.so/team-home: Empty authorized destination. No existing workspace or tracker.
sources.https://notion.so/source: Launch brief: audience is small design teams; message is faster feedback. Blog draft assigned to Mira. LinkedIn post is an idea, not approved.

search_routes.intent: Find source material for the requested workspace

success_criteria: Creates two distinct content items, leaves publish dates unset, preserves Mira ownership without inventing a user identity, and keeps the unapproved LinkedIn idea visible outside a date-only calendar.
Uses chat context without asking the user to restate it; fetches the source and destination before populating.
Creates a populated home with working navigation, clear hierarchy, and a first action; links source material and preserves original notes.
Verifies populated content and view semantics; reports visual inspection honestly.
